children: 字面义为“非人手所造”，通常指一幅圣像。
Lit., “not made by human hand”; usually of a sacred image.
安纳托利亚中部和东部的辖区，以驻扎于此的安纳托利孔军命名。该军最初受东方军务长官（magister militum per Orientem）指挥。
District in central and eastern Anatolia named after the army billeted there; originally that under the magister militum per Orientem.
君士坦丁堡的谷物供给；由实物税拨发的军用口粮。希腊语为 synonē。
Grain supply for Constantinople; Military rations issued from taxation collected in kind; Gr., synonē.
粮用莫狄乌斯，容积单位，合18.6磅或8.5千克。
A measure of volume: 18.6 pounds or 8.5 kilograms.
行省总督衔，宫廷等级体系中的高位。
Proconsul, a high-ranking grade in the palatine hierarchy.
国家用来储存各种货物及物资的仓库。7至9世纪指由商业官（kommerkiarios）掌管的仓库及其所属辖区。
A state depository for various goods and materials; in the seventh to ninth centuries, the warehouse, and the district to which it pertained, under the control of a kommerkiarios.
持有帝国头衔或官职的人。
Holders of imperial titles or offices.
安纳托利亚东部及亚美尼亚一带的辖区，以驻扎于此的亚美尼亚孔军命名。该军最初由亚美尼亚军务长官（magister militum per Armeniam）指挥。
District in eastern Anatolia/Armenia named after the army billeted there; originally that under the magister militum per Armeniam.
阿尔塔巴，埃及容积单位，合87.78罗马磅、28.7千克或63.2磅。
An Egyptian measure of volume: 87.78 Roman pounds or 28.7 kilograms / 63.2 pounds.
列名于迪万名册者领取的月饷。
Monthly salary drawn by those in the dīwān.
安纳托利亚一个可能奉二元论的教派，主要在吕考尼亚，起源或在印度或伊朗。
A probably dualist sect in Anatolia, esp. Lycaonia, possibly with origins in India or Iran.
拉丁语 imperator（皇帝）的希腊语对应词。尤其自7世纪以后用于强调皇帝独立行使上帝所赐的统治权。
Greek equivalent of the Latin imperator, emperor, used especially after the seventh century to emphasize the emperor’s autonomous and God-granted rule.
7世纪起拜占庭皇帝的正式称号。
Formal title of the Byzantine emperor from the seventh century.
布鲁马利亚节，为期约一个月的冬至庆典，从11月24日开始，持续到12月下旬萨图尔纳利亚节开幕。
Month-long winter solstice celebrations beginning on November 24 and lasting until the commencement of the Saturnalia in late December.
拉丁语作 collatio lustralis。对商业交换征收的一种税，由阿纳斯塔修斯（491—518年在位）废止，可能在希拉克略（610—641年在位）治下于埃及恢复。
Lat., collatio lustralis; a tax on commercial exchange, abolished by Anastasius (491–518), possibly reintroduced (in Egypt) under Heraclius (610–641).
元老等级中最低的一等。
《查士丁尼法典》，查士丁尼一世统治初期编纂的罗马法典，也是后来所有拜占庭法律的基础。
Codification of Roman law produced at the beginning of the reign of Justinian I and the basis for all later Byzantine law.
对谷物的强制收购，但7世纪后期以后也可能指强制征收的一项税。
Compulsory purchase of grain, but after the later seventh century possibly signifying an obligatory tax.
4至7世纪由军务长官（magistri militum）指挥的野战军士兵或部队，参见 limitanei。
Soldiers/units of the field armies under their magistri militum, fourth to seventh centuries (cf. limitanei).
晚期罗马的高级关税官，是商业官（kommerkiarioi）的前身。
Senior customs officials in the later Roman period, the predecessors of the kommerkiarioi.
皇帝的寝宫侍从，也是帝国等级体系中的一项官阶。
Imperial chamber attendant; rank in the imperial hierarchy.
希腊语为 kouratōr。国有、私人、教会或修道院地产的高级管理人。
Gr., kouratōr. Senior manager of an estate, state, private, ecclesiastical or monastic.
城市议会及其议员，为城市的治理机构。
Town council and councilors; governing body of a city.
国家邮驿与运输系统。直至6或7世纪，该体系分为快速邮驿（cursus velox）和较慢的运输业务（cursus clabularis）。
Public postal and transport service; until the sixth or seventh century organized into a rapid mail service (cursus velox) and a slower transport service (cursus clabularis).
赛战车的拥趸团体，有时成为政治或宗教暴力或抗议活动的中心。
Chariot-racing fan clubs, sometimes acting as foci of political/ religious violence or protest.
公库，即国家财政或国库。
拉丁语作 dioecesa，希腊语为 dioikēsis。由若干行省组成的行政辖区；从4世纪起，也指教会由主教管理的辖区。
Lat. dioecesa, Gr., dioikēsis; an administrative unit consisting of several provinces; from the fourth century, the episcopal administrative unit of the Church.
负责土地税的财政官，7世纪起通常管辖数个行省。
Fiscal administrator responsible for the land tax, usually in a group of provinces from the seventh century.
迪万，即定居于驻军据点或城镇、从征服地收入中领取给养的穆斯林名册。
The list of Muslims established in garrison settlements or towns who draw their incomes from the revenues of the conquered territories.
本指私人助手，后来衍生出许多含义，包括宫廷高级军事指挥官。
Originally a personal assistant, but came to have many meanings, including that of senior military palatine commander.
cursus publicus 的希腊语名称。
地方数支较小部队编为一旅时，其旅级指挥官。
Provincial brigade commander of several smaller units.
高级军事指挥官，7、8世纪尤常见于帝国西部。
Senior military commander, especially in the West in the seventh to eighth centuries.
《法律选编》，在利奥三世（717—741年在位）统治时期依据当时情况重新阐释罗马法律、选编成册的法律手册。直到巴西尔一世（867—886年在位）时期，仍是拜占庭的基本法书。

Selections from Roman law, interpreted in the light of its own time and codified as a handbook of Roman law during the reign of Leo III (717–741). The basic Byzantine law book until the time of the emperor Basil I (867–886).
《信仰阐述》，希拉克略颁布的通告，禁止讨论帝国宗教政策。
Imperial notice issued by Heraclius prohibiting discussion of imperial religious policy.
利奥一世从伊苏里亚山民中招募的一小支宫廷卫队。7世纪时沦为仪仗部队；760年代君士坦丁五世以 exkoubita 之名重建为规模更大的现役精锐团。

Small palace bodyguard recruited from Isaurian mountain people by the emperor Leo I. During the seventh century they became a show troop, but the unit was revived as a larger active elite regiment under Constantine V in the 760s as the exkoubita.
君士坦丁堡以外的军事首领，即地方指挥官。
Military leaders from outside Constantinople; provincial commanders.
法伊，传统阿拉伯语术语，指通过征服取得的战利品、地产及其他不动产。
Traditional Arabic term for booty, real estate, and other immovables acquired through conquest.
含义复杂的一组相关概念，历史上用于指哈里发国内争。最知名的是所谓第一次内战（656—661年，穆阿维叶与阿里争夺最高权力）、第二次内战（680—692年，穆阿维叶死后的继位争斗）和第三次内战（744—747年，马尔万家族内部的继位争斗）。此后还有一些内争也称为 fitna。

A complex term with many related meanings, used historically to refer to civil strife within the Caliphate. The best known are the so-called first fitna (656–661, Muʿāwiya’s war against Ali for supremacy), second fitna (680–692, the succession struggles following Muʿāwiya’s death), and third fitna (744–747, a succession struggle within the Marwanid family), although other, later civil conflicts are also referred to as fitna.
福利斯，小面值铜币，值40努米；288福利斯合一枚金币索利多或诺米斯玛。
Low value copper coin worth 40 nummi: there were 288 to the gold solidus or nomisma.
经官方签署、证明个人有旅行权的通行函件。
Officially endorsed pass letters confirming an individual’s right to travel.
希腊语为 endoxos。查士丁尼所设的高级元老衔。
Gr., endoxos; high-ranking senatorial title introduced by Justinian.
拉丁语 graecus 的希腊语形式，指帝国东方的人，有别于意大利人或西方人。
Hellenized form of Lat. graecus, used to indicate an Easterner as opposed to someone from Italy or the West.
希拉克略引入的一种银币，字面义为“六克”，十二枚合一诺米斯玛。希拉克略、君士坦斯二世在位时曾大量发行，此后使用渐少，至8世纪初停止铸造。

Silver coin introduced by Heraclius, lit., “six grams”; twelve to a nomisma. Although issued in large quanities under Heraclius and Constans II, its use dwindled until production ceased in the early eighth century.
个人通过自身劳动取得的财产。
Property acquired through one’s own labor.
直至6世纪中叶，最高一级的元老等级。
Until the middle of the sixth century, the highest grade of senatorial rank.
命令、指令或敕令；希腊语作 prostagma。
A command, order, or decree; Gr., prostagma.
堡垒，7世纪以后也可指城镇或城市。
Fortress, but after the seventh century, also used to mean town or city.
拉丁语作 clisura，指山间通道或关隘。
扼守关隘的部队之指挥官；也指该部队的指挥部或该关隘的管区。
Commander of the force controlling a kleisoura; the command of the force or pass.
奥普西基翁军指挥官，其部队驻于君士坦丁堡周边及安纳托利亚西北部。
The commander of the Opsikion division, based around Constantinople and in northwest Anatolia.
商业官，主管国家监督下的商业和相关税收的财政官。7、8世纪，他们在财政体系中的职能大为扩展，可能包括军队供应的某些事务；8世纪中叶起，主要职能重新转为商业管理。

Fiscal officials responsible for state-supervised commerce and the taxes thereon. During the seventh and eighth centuries had a much expanded role in the fiscal system, probably including aspects of supplying the armies; from the middle of the eighth century, reverted to chiefly commercial functions.
拉丁语 quaestor 的希腊语形式，指高级司法官。
Greek version of the Latin quaestor; senior legal official.
晚期罗马各省的边防驻军。
Provincial garrison troops in the later Roman period.
财政官，字面义为会计。7世纪起，各主要财政部门都由这类官员主持，他们的官阶通常很高。
Fiscal official; lit., accountant; from the seventh century, all the main fiscal bureaus were placed under such officials, who were often very high ranking.
军务长官，指挥军事单位，约660年以后为 stratēgos 所取代。
Divisional military commander, replaced by the stratēgos of the period after ca. 660.
查士丁尼所设的高级元老等级。
High-ranking senatorial grade introduced by Justinian.
传令官，亦为宫廷等级中的一项官阶。
Messenger; rank in the palatine hierarchy.
埃德萨圣巾，方形或矩形的圣物，布上显有神迹印成的耶稣面容。
The mandylion of Edessa, a holy relic consisting of a square or rectangle of cloth upon which a miraculous image of the face of Jesus is imprinted.
一性论。基督教中的一类教义，拒绝承认基督兼具人性与神性，主张道成肉身后，人性已纳入神性。451年卡尔西顿会议将其斥为异端，但它仍在叙利亚和埃及大片地区居主流地位，也是今日叙利亚教会和科普特教会的主要信仰。

Doctrine of the single nature; Christian tendency rejecting the two natures, both human and divine, of Christ, believing instead that the divine subsumed the human nature after the incarnation. Condemned as heretical at council of Chalcedon in 451, but remained the majority creed in large parts of Syria and Egypt, and of the Syrian and Coptic churches today.
拉丁语作 milliarensis，银币，值索利多或诺米斯玛的十二分之一。原先每磅银可铸72枚。7至11世纪指基本银币，每磅铸币数量在108至144枚之间，尤其指利奥三世在位时经改革推出的银币。

Lat., milliarensis, a silver coin worth one-twelfth of a solidus/ nomisma. Originally struck at 72 to the pound, from the seventh to eleventh centuries used of the basic silver coin, struck at varying rates from 144 to 108 to the pound, especially of the reformed silver coin introduced under Leo III.
莫狄乌斯，既是面积单位也是容积单位，其定量随地区和用途而异。
A measure of both area and volume, differing both regionally and according to function.
一能论，牧首塞尔吉乌斯为使一性论和二性论群体和解所采取的折中方案。它把两性的争论置于次要地位，强调两性统一于同一个神圣的活动。提出数年之内即为各方所拒，并于681年的第六次普世公会议上被判为异端。

Compromise formula adopted by the patriarch Sergius aimed at reconciliation between Miaphysite and Dyophysite communities, by which the issue of the two natures was made secondary to the notion that they were united in a single divine energy. Rejected by all parties within a few years of its being proposed, and condemned as heretical at the sixth ecumenical council in 681.
一志论，塞尔吉乌斯提出并获希拉克略皇帝支持的第二次折中尝试。其关键在于承认单一神圣意志，将本性与活动统摄于其中。君士坦斯二世在位时推行该教义，681年会议则予以谴责和拒斥。

A second attempt at compromise proposed by Sergius and supported by the emperor Heraclius, by which the key issue was acceptance of the notion of a single divine will, within which natures and energy were subsumed. Imposed during the reign of Constans II, but condemned and rejected at the council of 681.
纳哈拉尔，亚美尼亚贵族成员所持的世袭称号。
Hereditary title held by members of the Armenian nobility.
拉丁语作 navicularius。商船主，亦可指承包政府或教会海上运输的人。
Lat., navicularius; masters of merchant ships, also maritime contractors to the government or church.
诺米斯玛，拉丁语作 solidus，君士坦丁一世推出的金币。直到1204年拉丁人征服君士坦丁堡，它仍是拜占庭贵金属铸币的基础。重4.5克，账面计为24克拉（keratia）。其分币折合12枚银制赫克萨格拉姆或米利亚雷西翁，也可折合288枚铜制福利斯。

Lat., solidus; the gold coin introduced by Constantine I which remained the basis for the Byzantine precious metal coinage until the Latin conquest in 1204. Weighing 4.5 grams, it was reckoned at 24 keratia, a unit of account (carat), and its fractions were 12 silver hexagrams or milliaresia and 288 copper folleis.
字面义为“经管”，但通常有“特许”之意。
Lit., economy, but generally with the sense of “license.”
有人居住的世界，亦指文明世界。
奥普西基翁。拉丁语作 Obsequium，原指随行的队列或侍从。自7世纪中叶起，也指驻君士坦丁堡及其周边的帝国野战军。
Lat., Obsequium; originally an accompanying procession or retinue, from the middle of the seventh century also applied to the imperial field army based in and around Constantinople.
罗马法中拥有绝对权力的家长。
In Roman law the head of a household with absolute authority.
贵族（patrician），授予帝国宫廷及行政中最重要人物的高级宫廷头衔。
Patrician, a senior court title awarded to the most important members of the imperial court and administration.
家产，即属于一个家户的财物和资产；也用来指皇室的地产和土地。
Property and possessions belonging to a household; used of the imperial estates and lands.
拉丁语作 bucellatum，配发给士兵的硬饼干。
Lat., bucellatum; hard tack issued to soldiers.
军役特有财产，个人在服役期间获得的财物，包括现金收入、遗赠和战利品，有别于其他收入或家产。士兵无需与受其供养的人或其他家庭成员分享这类财产。

Goods (including cash income, legacies, and booty) acquired by an individual during service as a soldier, and distinct from other income or patrimony. The soldier held such property with no obligation to share it with dependents or other members of his family.
特有财产，个人独占的财物及资产。
Property and possessions held by a person as their own exclusive possession.
大区，君士坦丁一世以来帝国最大的行政单位，由大区长官主管。此官原是禁卫军指挥官。各大区下分若干管区，管区又下分行省，各大区有自己的财政行政与司法体系。

The largest administrative unit of the empire from the time of Constantine I, under a praetorian prefect (originally a commander of the praetorian guard). Each prefecture was divided into dioceses and then provinces, and each had its own fiscal administrative and judicial structure.
首席持剑侍卫。原来是实职，从7世纪起成为宫廷官阶。
Senior spatharios, or sword bearer. Originally an active post; from the seventh century a palatine grade.
皇室私库，源于皇帝的私人财政。7世纪并入皇室地产部门。
Imperial treasury, originating in emperor’s private finances. Subsumed during the seventh century into the department of imperial estates.
发放给士兵或国家官员的薪俸或饷银。
Salary or wages paid to soldiers or state official.
每年夏季由叙利亚向拜占庭领土发动的远征。
The annual summer campaign from Syria against Byzantine lands.
神圣财赋署，源于皇帝家政机构的国家财政部门，至7世纪之前负责金银原料及铸币。
Government fiscal department originating in the imperial household, responsible for bullion and coinage until the seventh century.
国库长官。7世纪以后负责监督其他财政部门的高级财政官，原先管理皇帝个人的财库或钱袋（sacellum／sakellion）。
Senior fiscal officer with oversight over other fiscal departments after the seventh century. Originally in charge of emperor’s personal treasury or purse (sacellum/sakellion).
5、6世纪巴尔干地区的叛乱者或匪徒。
Rebels or bandits in the Balkan region during the fifth and sixth centuries.
自君士坦丁一世至5世纪后期的一支精锐骑兵，到5世纪后期已是仪仗部队。君士坦丁五世改革这些部队，使其重新成为精锐军团，直至11世纪都是帝国野战军的核心。

In the period from Constantine I until the later fifth century, a crack cavalry unit; by the later fifth century, a show force. The units were reformed and became once more elite regiments under Constantine V, forming until the eleventh century the core of the imperial field armies.
半枚索利多或诺米斯玛。
Half of a solidus or nomisma.
A department dealing with grain provision.
持剑侍卫，6、7世纪起成为一项宫廷官阶。
Sword bearer, a palatine rank from the sixth and seventh centuries.
将军，通常指一支地方驻军的长官。
A general; usually the governor of a provincial military force.
拉丁语作 coemptio。7世纪后期起用于指每年征收的一项谷物税。
Lat. coemptio, from the later seventh century applied to an annual tax in grain.
The territory under the jurisdiction of a city.
军区。9世纪初起作为财政术语，指供养地方驻军的安排，也指以此方式供养的军队所辖的地区。
A fiscal term describing the arrangements for supporting provincial soldiers from the early ninth century; the territory of the army thus supported.
色雷西翁军，即色雷斯军务长官（magister militum per Thracias）所辖军队，也指该军640年代起在安纳托利亚西部占据的地区。
The army of the magister militum per Thracias, and the territory occupied by that army in western Anatolia from the 640s.
地方军事指挥官，统辖两个或两个以上的旅。
A provincial military commander in charge of two or more brigades.
《信仰规范》，君士坦斯二世于648年颁布的文书，禁止继续讨论一志论。
Document issued by Constans II in 648 prohibiting further discussion of the doctrine of the single will.
原指助手或副职，后来指拥有民事或军事权力的高级官员。
Originally an assistant or second-in-command; later a senior officer with civil or military authority.
异教信众奉献给一位或多位神的供品或献物。拉丁语单数为 votum，复数为 vota。
Pagan offerings or dedications to a god or gods; Lat., votum, pl. vota.
